main_text.l: antiquitatem tùm ex ipsissimis S. Scri-
vestigatas, describere, (quæ res cum scitu iucundissima est: tum
verò ad veram pietatis agnitionem, id est, tum
nostræ damnationis, tum redemptionis causas explicandas,
nosq; in fide confirmandos necessaria) primùm in quot
ætates, distinctaq; secula tota Mundi huius durant.
[Note: the body text of this paragraph runs over the page edge at the foot; the final word is cut off.]

page.notes: The woodcut initial "V" (decorated Q-shaped letter) is at the left; the first word is "VONIAM" where "NONIAM" would be expected; the initial letter is a large decorative capital and was read as V.
